First release of bootleap: a command line tool that reads a Spring Boot 3 project and lists what will break on Spring Boot 4, with the file, the line and what to change. It does not run your build and does not touch your code.

### Download

`bootleap.jar` below. It needs Java 17 or later:

```
java -jar bootleap.jar path/to/your/project
```

`bootleap.jar.sha256` has the checksum. The jar is built by the [Release workflow](https://github.com/JooaoGui/bootleap/actions/workflows/release.yml) from the tagged commit.

### What it checks

- `gradle-version`: Gradle wrappers older than 8.14
- `artifact`: removed starters (`aop`, `undertow`, `pulsar-reactive`), deprecated ones (`web`, `web-services`, `oauth2-*`) and `hibernate-jpamodelgen`
- `migration-starter`: `flyway-core` or `liquibase-core` without their starter, which makes the migrations stop running
- `testcontainers-2`: the 61 renamed Testcontainers modules, `dynalite`, and JUnit 4 `@Rule`/`@ClassRule` containers
- `jackson-3`: Jackson 2 imports and the Spring Boot Jackson classes renamed in 4.0
- `mock-bean`: `@MockBean`, `@SpyBean` and the rest of the removed Mockito package
- `moved-class`: imports of the ~770 Spring Boot classes that changed package, for 4.0, 4.1 and 4.2

The Spring Boot version to check against is read from your build (on a Dependabot branch it is already the new 4.x), or set with `--to`.

### Feedback

This is an early version. If it reports something wrong, or misses something that broke on your upgrade, please [open an issue](https://github.com/JooaoGui/bootleap/issues) with the error message.
